culprit_citations.quoted_text: Overton Chicago Gear, LLC (fka H-D Advanced Manufacturing Company) (4) | 08/22/24 | Term Loan A - 6.00 % inc PIK ( 6.00 %, Fixed Coupon, all PIK) | 16.0 | % | 40,929,861 | 01/31/28 | 40,915,831 | 40,929,861

findings.detail: basis_spread was populated with the row's 16.0% net-assets value even though the instrument terms state a 6.00% fixed coupon with all PIK and no spread.

rationale: C115 is a Class 1 row-level single-cell issue for basis_spread. The raw schedule row shows the loan terms as a fixed 6.00% all-PIK coupon, while 16.0 appears under the % of Net Assets column. Therefore the stored basis_spread value of 16.0 is not supported by the source terms and is a localized extraction/column mapping error.
